description.en: Open the Explorer at Crocodylomorpha to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开鳄形类，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 卡罗莱纳屠夫鳄出现窗口

description.en: Open a source-bounded Carnufex time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的卡罗莱纳屠夫鳄时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare Archaeopteryx and Neornithes through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较始祖鸟与今鸟类；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 鳄类末端定年模型窗口

description.en: Open the 72 Ma edge of the available Crocodylia navigation interval to inspect the Lee–Yates tip-dated fossil-and-molecular model alongside sampled map context.
description.zh: 打开可用鳄类导航区间的 72 Ma 边界，在采样地图背景旁检查 Lee–Yates 化石与分子末端定年模型。

limitations: The 72 Ma selector follows the package’s study-level Crocodylia navigation interval; the Lee–Yates result is a model built from sampled living and extinct taxa, not a direct fossil date or crown FAD/LAD.
The combined topology and inferred divergence times depend on taxon sampling, character treatment, molecular data, priors and clock model; no sampled branch is a directly observed ancestor.

The CAO2024 map frame supplies age context while markers remain bounded occurrence samples; this scene does not establish complete distribution, observed behaviour, or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: 瑟莫波利斯始祖鸟骨架窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 149 Ma Bavarian lithographic-limestone window to inspect the nearly complete Thermopolis specimen, later catalogued WDC CSG 100, beside its source-linked anatomical claim.
description.zh: 打开约 149 Ma 的巴伐利亚石印灰岩窗口，在来源关联的解剖主张旁检查近乎完整的瑟莫波利斯标本（后编为 WDC CSG 100）。

limitations: The 150–148 Ma route is the package’s referred Archaeopteryx horizon envelope, not a direct date on WDC CSG 100 or a global avialan/crown-bird FAD or LAD.

The hyperextendible second toe, tetraradiate palatine and hallux are specimen observations; posture, perching capacity and theropod-affinity implications remain comparative interpretations, not observed behaviour or direct ancestry.
The CAO2024 map frame supplies age context while markers remain bounded occurrence samples; the scene does not establish complete distribution or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: 阿斯忒里鸟马斯特里赫特期正模窗口

description.en: Open the 66.8–66.7 Ma Maastricht Formation window to inspect CT-imaged holotype NHMM 2013 008 and its competing near-crown placements in the cited primary study.
description.zh: 打开 66.8–66.7 Ma 马斯特里赫特组窗口，检查 CT 成像正模标本 NHMM 2013 008 及其在一手研究中竞争性的近冠群位置。

limitations: NHMM 2013 008 and its Maastricht Formation horizon in Belgium are the bounded specimen evidence; the rounded midpoint is not a direct skull date or a global crown-bird FAD/LAD.
Parsimony and tip-dated Bayesian analyses place Asteriornis differently near the crown, so the topology is method-dependent and does not establish direct ancestry or a complete distribution.

The CAO2024 map frame supplies age context while markers remain bounded occurrence samples; possible littoral ecology is an inference and the scene does not establish observed behaviour or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: 冠群鸟类化石校准时间树窗口

description.en: Open the 69.2–68.4 Ma fossil-bounded Neornithes window to inspect the spatial context beside the Claramunt–Cracraft time-tree result, whose crown-age estimate is model-based.
description.zh: 打开 69.2–68.4 Ma 化石限定的冠群鸟类窗口，在 Claramunt–Cracraft 时间树结果旁检查空间背景；其冠群年龄估计来自模型。

limitations: The routed age follows the package’s available Vegavis-linked crown-bird test window; the approximately 95 Ma common-ancestor estimate is a fossil-calibrated Bayesian model, not a fossil occurrence or direct crown-bird FAD.

The estimate and South American ancestral-area reconstruction depend on calibrations, priors, topology and sampling; they do not establish direct ancestry, complete distribution or observed dispersal behaviour.
The CAO2024 map frame supplies age context while markers remain bounded occurrence samples; this scene does not imply exact fossil-to-map co-registration.
